trans-unit.target: Width of the passe-partout framing a displayed media: "none" (no frame, the photo laid flat), "thin" (10px, the default) or "wide" (25px). Its color is the theme's own ink, white on a dark gallery and black on a light one; it is set apart in this group.

Number of calendar days, today included, the automatic gallery shows the medias added over - 7 by default. If nothing was added over that period, it falls back on the last day carrying an addition, so it is never empty as long as a single photo exists. Empty or 0, 7 is applied.

Maximum number of medias the automatic gallery shows, 200 by default. It guards the day a whole library came in at once - a migration, an import - which would otherwise fill the page with thousands of thumbnails. Past it, only the most recent ones are shown. Empty or 0, 200 is applied.
The key the lab issued, which authenticates every order sent. Not needed with "manual". Filling it in does not open the shop: the "Print sales" box is what does that.

Opens the print shop: the order button appears under photographs marked as sellable, and paid orders go to the lab. While this is unchecked, everything else can be configured and tested without anything showing to visitors.
Name of the lab that prints - "prodigi" for print on demand, "manual" to place orders yourself from the back-office. A site running its own driver puts that driver's name here.

Sends orders to the lab's test environment: they are accepted, nothing is printed and nothing is charged. Uncheck it on opening day and not before - otherwise every trial is a real print, really paid for.

Path, from public/, of the signature image laid on print files. It is composed again at print size rather than taken from the web image, which would be blurred once enlarged. Left empty, prints go out unsigned.
Maximum number of photographs shown by the prints gallery, 200 by default. It gathers the photographs flagged as for sale, whatever gallery they were filed in. Empty or 0, 200 is applied.
Shows a heart under a photo, which visitors click to say they like it. One gesture, no score: the page says how many people liked it

First segment of the gallery's public urls, e.g. "gallery" for /gallery/my-category. A change applies straight away, but the previous urls then return a not found page: set up a redirect if they were indexed. Left empty, the "gallery" prefix applies.

Ready-made style of the gallery, applied to the index, the categories and each media: "light" (near-white page) or "dark" (near-black page). The style redefines the site's own colors for those pages alone - background, text, titles, links, navbar and footer included - and wins over the site's dark mode. Left empty, the gallery takes the site's own colors, as before.

Off (default): the thumbnail fills its square, cropped from the centre, which hides the edges of a photo that is not square. On: the whole photo fits inside the square, the bands left around it taking the --gallery-thumb-background token's colour. The thumbnail file holds the whole photo either way, only the display changes: switching is immediate and regenerates nothing.
Color veiling the page behind the opened high resolution. Left empty, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9) applies. A CSS color: a hex with its # (#ff0000), rgb() or a name.
Background of the badge marking a thumbnail that opens a video player. Left empty, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55) applies. A CSS color: a hex with its # (#ff0000), rgb() or a name.
Color of the triangle of the video badge. Left empty, the #fff white applies. A CSS color: a hex with its # (#ff0000), rgb() or a name.
Color of the breadcrumb opening every page of the gallery. Left empty, color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 60%, var(--background)) applies. A CSS color: a hex with its # (#ff0000), rgb() or a name.
Color of the credits and reserved rights shown under a media. Empty: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 60%, var(--background)) applies. A CSS color: hexadecimal with its # (#ff0000), rgb() or name.

Color of the passe-partout framing a displayed media, its width being set apart in this group. Left empty, var(--text), the theme's own ink applies - white on a dark gallery and black on a light one, a mount the color of its ground being a mount nobody sees. A CSS color: a hex with its # (#ff0000), rgb() or a name.

Color of the chevron of the previous/next arrows sitting on the media. Left empty, the #fff white applies, the arrows being laid on the photo rather than on the page. A CSS color: a hex with its # (#ff0000), rgb() or a name.
Background of the previous/next arrow buttons. Left empty, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55) applies. A CSS color: a hex with its # (#ff0000), rgb() or a name.
Color of the chevron on hover and on keyboard focus. Left empty, var(--gallery-nav-color), the arrows color applies. A CSS color: a hex with its # (#ff0000), rgb() or a name.
